# Architecture: Build Boundary

Vite is the production bundler and preview server. The build command is finite and writes static output; preview serves the built output separately.

| Concern | Observed value | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Module system | module | [package.json](../../../../package.json) |
| Build command | vite build | [package.json](../../../../package.json) |
| Test command | vitest run | [package.json](../../../../package.json) |
| Syntax command | find src -name '*.js' -exec node --check {} + | [package.json](../../../../package.json) |

The generator documents this boundary and adds spec drift checking; it does not replace the build system.
